notes.title: Price Drop!
notes.content: While our games are on sale right now, the regular price of Suki's Spooky Romance has been lowered forever to match the regular price of Unrested Development. Both games are now $1.99 U.S. all the time, but they are a steal at the sale price of 60% off!

notes.title: On Sale!
notes.content:
Suki's Spooky Romance is part of the Steam Summer Sale.

Buy it alone, or as part of  The Whole Cow bundle.

Happy gaming!
